observations.result: Heading, Close control, purpose selection, query and location labels fit at 320px. Visible property-type buttons and sticky footer have no overlap.
Both price values are fully readable. Validation message wraps to two lines within the panel; count, reset link and disabled Apply presentation remain distinct.
Amenity labels and Listing status fit the scrollable body. Status select sits fully above the fixed footer; Close, count, Reset and Apply remain visible.
Normal and reduced-motion terminal screenshots use consistent panel geometry. Background-film frame differences do not affect panel readability.

limitations: Only the six named PNGs have been visually reviewed in this receipt; the remaining focused matrix, WebKit and all-canonical-page capture are not accepted here.
Static screenshots establish the rendered state, not motion timing, keyboard behavior or draft semantics; functional evidence belongs to the separately recorded automated run.
The scrollable panel intentionally clips content beyond its body boundaries. No claim is made that all body content is simultaneously visible.
No live API writes or browser sessions were performed by this reviewer.
